intro: A live, high-level view of what the autonomous engineering bot is working on across the Northstar projects. Bot-maintained and current-state only — git history is the changelog. Public-safe by design: titles, projects and status only, no secrets or internal detail.

lanes.title: In progress
lanes.hint: Actively being built by the bot right now.

items.title: Deliberate production freeze — finish, don't start
items.note: The bot is opening no new work while the review queue is long: depth on one project at a time, keep the existing pile mergeable, and hand over the decisions rather than inventing more code.

items.title: Code-health tracking
items.note: Churn balance, template drift and duplicate mass are now measured every review cycle, so "is this getting out of hand" has a number instead of an opinion.

lanes.title: Awaiting you
lanes.hint: Done by the bot; needs your review, merge or a decision.

items.title: Decision queue — every open question, with the default
items.note: One ranked list of the 10 open questions, each stating what the bot will do if you say nothing and the date it acts. Silence becomes a decision instead of a blockage.

items.title: Design system: which theme is which product's identity?
items.note: Two themes are built and rendered side by side. This one call gates rolling the design system into every app — adopting before it is settled means retheming everything twice.

items.title: snip-it: public and unauthenticated, or gated?
items.note: The app works end to end and is ready to deploy. Last call before it goes live: put it behind auth, or accept anonymous uploads.

items.title: Studio theme — dark-first identity for tool UIs
items.note: Second theme option, rendered and screenshot-tested.

items.title: Design-system consumer registry + tokens-only entry point
items.note: Lets a project take just the tokens without the components.

items.title: Trim landing page + retire public sprint board
items.note: Net −1,500 lines. Green on backend, frontend and e2e.

items.title: Promote the 12-template video library to main
items.note: 5,394 lines merged into dev in July that never reached the default branch. Promotion only — no new code.

items.title: Stop the template seeding portfolio screenshots into new repos
items.note: 1.9 MB of images from this site leaked into the app template and every repo generated from it — 87% of one repo by bytes, referenced nowhere but here.

items.title: Make the bot's delegation rule actually deliverable
items.note: Harness fix so the bot can hand cheap survey work to smaller models. Needs a merge and an image rebuild.

items.title: Operating rules: freeze, no new tools, hand over the action
items.note: The three rules the last quarterly-style review concluded with.

lanes.title: Backlog
lanes.hint: Next up when its turn comes — things the bot can pick up unaided.

items.title: Roll the design system into the apps, one repo at a time
items.note: Ordered programme: snip-it, then this site, then the template. Gated on the identity decision above.

items.title: Purge the stray portfolio images from three more repos
items.note: Same images as the template PR above, copied forward into snip-it, macro-metrics and holiday-planning.

items.title: One-command video build + a folder convention that holds
items.note: The two existing videos each follow a different subset of the documented layout, so a wrapper built today would work for one of them.

items.title: Walkthrough videos for the deployed projects
items.note: macro-metrics and holiday-planning are built; the remaining value is a walkthrough, not more code.

items.title: Habits app — Manage screen
items.note: Last v1 screen (add / edit / archive). Waiting on the Today + History PRs, which have been open a month.

lanes.title: Needs you at your desk
lanes.hint: Can't be done from your phone or by the bot — needs your laptop / accounts.

items.title: Take snip-it live
items.note: Three steps once the auth call is made: cluster secrets, promote to the release branch, then a deployment PR.

items.title: Rebuild the bot image after merging its harness PR
items.note: Merging alone changes nothing — the image ships the harness, and it only builds from the release branch.

items.title: Permission emails for whos-accountable data sources
items.note: Three emails to send and track before those scoring pillars can be wired in.

items.title: Decide the fate of eight stalled PRs
items.note: Open 28–67 days across five repos. The bot resurfaces them but never closes them — closing is yours.

lanes.title: Recently shipped
lanes.hint: Merged recently — ages out over time; git keeps the full history.

items.title: snip-it works end to end: upload → transcribe → edit → export
items.note: Five stacked PRs. The editor had been talking to a fixture, not the backend.

items.title: CI that actually runs the tests, in eleven repos
items.note: Most repos only ever compiled on a PR; three had no CI at all.

items.title: Two high-severity advisories closed in three backends
items.note: Fixed in the template months ago and never rippled outward.

items.title: Lint clean across the org — 33 errors to 0
items.note: The same two scaffold errors sat in four separate repos.

items.title: First backend test suite for this site
items.note: 12 tests covering the newsletter sign-up, no database needed.

items.title: Design system — first slice
items.note: Tokens, the casual theme, primitives and a live showcase.

youtubeBacklog.title: Autonomous bot — the usage-limit death arc
youtubeBacklog.note: Build-in-public story of the bot working across sessions. Needs shaping once the full YouTube library context lands.

youtubeBacklog.title: snip-it demo — the first app the bot took to production
youtubeBacklog.note: Upload a clip, cut it by selecting words, export. Best filmed once it is live.

youtubeBacklog.title: macro-metrics walkthrough
youtubeBacklog.note: Deployed proof-of-concept — the remaining value is a walkthrough video, not more code.
